nodes.description: Private uint256 secret number (1-10) that players must guess; written by shuffle and read by play.
Public timestamp of the last play() call; used by kill() to enforce a 1 day delay.
Public bet price of 0.1 ether; checked against msg.value in play().
Public owner address set in the constructor from msg.sender; gates kill().
Public array of Game structs recording every bet placed.
Constructor: sets ownerAddr to msg.sender and seeds the secret number via shuffle().
Internal function that derives secretNumber from sha3(now, blockhash(block.number-1)) % 10 + 1 (predictable randomness).
Payable betting function: records the bet, pays the whole balance on a correct guess, then reshuffles and updates lastPlayed.
Owner-gated selfdestruct guarded by a 1 day delay since lastPlayed.
Payable fallback function that silently accepts ether without any bookkeeping.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, player, transfer recipient and suicide beneficiary.
Block timestamp (now) used as randomness input in shuffle(), as the recorded lastPlayed value and in the kill() time check.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) sends the entire contract balance to the winner.
secretNumber derived from block.timestamp and blockhash, both miner-influenceable/predictable.
suicide(msg.sender) destroys the contract and sends all funds to the caller.
User-supplied guess (must be <= 10) passed into play().
Local Game struct assembled inside play() and pushed to gamesPlayed.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as ownerAddr in the constructor, granting privileged rights.
msg.sender is recorded as game.player and used as the payout recipient inside play().
The caller-supplied msg.sender receives the full contract balance via transfer.
The caller-supplied msg.sender is the beneficiary of suicide().
block.timestamp (now) is hashed to choose the secret number, making it miner/timestamp dependent.
The timestamp feeds the weak randomness operation that produces secretNumber.
now is compared against lastPlayed + 1 days, so the kill() outcome depends on block.timestamp.
Predictable randomness computed from timestamp/blockhash directly determines secretNumber.
Constructor assigns ownerAddr from msg.sender, establishing privileged ownership.
Constructor invokes shuffle() to initialise secretNumber.
play() calls shuffle() after every bet to re-randomise secretNumber.
play() executes the external balance transfer when the guess matches secretNumber.
kill() calls suicide(msg.sender) only when the owner and time checks pass.
The external transfer to msg.sender can re-enter play() before state is finalised.
shuffle() writes the newly generated value into secretNumber.
play() reads secretNumber to compare it with the player's guess.
play() sets lastPlayed = now, manipulating the timestamp gate used by kill().
play() pushes the assembled Game entry into the gamesPlayed array.
play() requires msg.value to be at least betPrice.
kill() reads ownerAddr to verify msg.sender equals the owner.
kill() reads lastPlayed to enforce the one day delay before selfdestruct.
User-supplied number parameter drives the win condition inside play().
Local Game struct carries msg.sender and number into gamesPlayed within play().
